title: Like a River Glorious
lyrics_original: Like a river glorious, is God's perfect peace,
Over all victorious, in its bright increase;
Perfect, yet it floweth, fuller every day,
Perfect, yet it groweth, deeper all the way.
Stayed upon Jehovah,
Hearts are fully blest
Finding, as He promised,
Perfect peace and rest.
Hidden in the hollow of His blessed hand,
Never foe can follow, never traitor stand;
Not a surge of worry, not a shade of care,
Not a blast of hurry touch the spirit there.
Stayed upon Jehovah,
Hearts are fully blest
Finding, as He promised,
Perfect peace and rest.
Every joy or trial falleth from above,
Traced upon our dial by the Sun of Love;
We may trust Him fully all for us to do.
They who trust Him wholly find Him wholly true.
Stayed upon Jehovah,
Hearts are fully blest
Finding, as He promised,
Perfect peace and rest.

bible_verses.english: You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you.
Oh that you had listened to my commandments! then your peace would have been like a river, and your righteousness like the waves of the sea:
And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord God, thank You for the gift of Your perfect peace that flows continuously into my life. When worries try to overwhelm me, help me to keep my heart fixed on You and trust in Your faithful promises. Hide me in the safety of Your hand, and let Your quiet rest guard my mind today. May my trust in You deepen with every passing moment. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: The peace God offers is not a static pond, but a deep, ever-flowing river that expands as we walk with Him. Even when life feels turbulent, His presence remains victorious, sheltering us safely in the hollow of His hand. As you sing this hymn, fix your heart on the unchanging love of Jesus and allow His rest to quiet your anxious thoughts. Let every word remind you that trusting Him yields a peace that only grows fuller day by day.
